description.value:
Frequency once per day

By tapping into your ancestral connection to the Netherworld, your corporeal form transforms into the stuff of shadow. For 1 minute, you become as insubstantial as shadow. You gain the incorporeal trait and resistance 10 to all damage except force, spirit, and damage from Strikes with weapons with the ghost touch property; double this resistance against non-magical damage. However, whenever you are in an area of bright light, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard]; you can't remove these conditions for as long as you remain in bright light. You can Dismiss this ability, returning to your solid form.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
